mapper.select: SELECT fpl.id, fpl.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, p.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age, p.phone, p.id_card, p.medical_record_no, fpl.source, fpl.application_time, fpl.enrollment_time, fpl.primary_doctor, fpl.health_manager, fpl.followup_team, fpl.followup_plan_name, fpl.followup_project, fpl.followup_status, fpl.remark, fpl.created_time FROM followup_patient_list fpl LEFT JOIN patient p ON fpl.patient_id = p.id WHERE fpl.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM followup_patient_list WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} LIMIT 1
